dataset_rule: Clinic-first public-price audit. For every included clinic/location, procedures[] contains every numeric-priced treatment/service captured from the reviewed public pages, not only Botox, fillers, rhinoplasty, breast augmentation, hair transplant or peels.

trust_policy.official_public_price_page: Direct public clinic/practice price page; preferred.
trust_policy.official_context_price: Clinic's own public planning or market range, not a personalized quote.
trust_policy.official_network_price: Price published by a multi-location practice/network, not necessarily location-specific.
trust_policy.public_pricing_directory: Third-party public directory/crowdsourced price; lower trust than official clinic pricing.

limitations: Best-effort public-web snapshot; booking-only, private-quote, login-only, phone-only and unindexed prices may be absent.
Rows without a numeric public price were omitted rather than estimated.
Starting, range, package, member, per-unit, per-syringe, per-vial and per-graft semantics are preserved.
Public promotional prices are labeled and should be revalidated before being used as a current default card price.
Third-party/crowdsourced prices are explicitly marked with source_type=public_pricing_directory and should rank below direct official clinic-site prices.
San Diego metro coverage includes La Jolla, La Mesa, Del Mar, Solana Beach, Carlsbad and Oceanside where relevant.
